title: My Quiet Bible · Bala, khuleka, yabelana, uphinde
description: Bala, khuleka, yabelana, uphinde. IBhayibhili ngezinguqulo ezingu-{{versions}} langezilimi ezingu-{{languages}}, inkinobho ye-🙏 yokukhuleka ngelizwi ngalokho elikubalayo, lamaqembu amancane ayimfihlo okwabelana ngemikhuleko yenu. Kumahala, akulazikhangiso, kusebenza kungela-inthanethi.
sub: IBhayibhili kuphela: akulamahlelo, akulazindaba eziphuphumayo, akulazikhangiso. Kumahala, njalo kusebenza kungela-inthanethi.
hint: Akulakubhalisa. Kuvuleka lapha khona esipheqululini senu.
verseSub:
Izinguqulo ezingu-{{versions}} ngezilimi ezingu-{{languages}}, zonke zingezomphakathi kumbe zilelayisensi evulekileyo.
          Ivesi elilodwa, kwezinye zazo:
biblesP: Izinguqulo ezingu-{{versions}} ngezilimi ezingu-{{languages}}: iKing James, iLouis Segond 1910, uLuther, iReina-Valera, iBhayibhili lesiHebheru leTestamente Elitsha lesiGreki, ikhanoni yaseEthiopia ngesiNgisi, isiFulentshi lesiGe'ez, lokunye. Qathanisani ezifika kweziyisithupha eceleni.
searchP: Ilizwi, umusho, amazwi amabili aseduze, eBhayibhilini elilodwa kumbe kwamanengi, imiphumela ibalwa ngebhuku. Thayiphani isikhombo selifika khona. Lenombolo zikaStrong.
offlineP: AmaBhayibhili elibalayo ahlala efonini yenu. Endizeni, ezintabeni, ngaphansi komhlaba: kuvuleka evesini elayima kulo, kungelaxhumano lakancane.
marksP: Imibala eyisitshiyagalombili, inothi evesini kumbe esiqephini sonke, uphawu lwezindawo elibuyela kuzo. Lethani lokho elakugcina kwenye i-app yeBhayibhili. Phawula ivesi njengokungathi ngepeni elikhanyisayo, kumbe ufake imibala ezinhlamvwini zalo.
devicesP: Nxa lifuna kuphela. Ngenani nge-passkey kumbe ngekhodi ethunyelwe nge-imeyili, njalo okugqanyisiweyo, amanothi lezilungiselelo zenu kuyalilandela. Idivayisi yesibili ingena ivela kweyokuqala ngelinki eyodwa; akulalutho lokuthayipha.
readingP: Amafonti ayisithupha, elinye lawo lenzelwe abangaboni kuhle. Umbhalo omkhulu njengoba lidinga, lezinkinobho ezibonakalayo. Swayiphani ukuze liphenye isahluko. Kukhanyayo, Isepiya kumbe Kumnyama, njengaleli khasi.
nots:
• Akulamahlelo okubala. Akulazifundo zansuku zonke. Akulalutho olukhethelwe lina.
  • Akulazikhangiso. Akulakulandelelwa. Akulama-cookie.
  • Akulakubhadala. Akulalutho oluvaliweyo.
  • Akudingeki i-akhawunti. Ngenani kuphela nxa lifuna ukuvumelanisa.
free: I-My Quiet Bible ingeyamahala, njalo izahlala injalo. Nxa iyalisiza, lingakwenza ukusiza ukuthi isibane sihlale sibasekile. Akulalutho oluzakwencika kukho.
installSub: Lapho-ke ivuleka isikrini sigcwele njengayo yonke enye i-app, igcina indawo yenu, njalo isebenza kungelaxhumano.
installSubComputer: Lapho-ke ivuleka ewindini layo njengayo yonke enye i-app, igcina indawo yenu, njalo isebenza kungelaxhumano.
iosSteps:
• Vulani iBhayibhili ku-Safari.
  • Thintani inkinobho yemenyu emgqeni wekheli, lapho-ke Share {svg}. Kuma-iPhone amadala, Share ingqo emgqeni ongezansi.
  • Thintani View More, lapho-ke Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Tshiyani Open as Web App kuvuliwe lithinte Add. Isibane sizavela esikrinini senu sasekhaya.
iosNote: Kwenzeni kusukela eBhayibhilini, hatshi kuleli khasi, ukuze isibane sivuleke ngqo ekubaleni kwenu. Sebenzisani iSafari: ezinye iziphequluli ku-iPhone lo-iPad kazenelisi ngaso sonke isikhathi ukwengeza i-app.
orSafari: Kumbe, ngaphandle kwe-App Store, kusukela ku-Safari:
androidNote: Ukuthinta kanye. Akulalutho oludlula esitolo sama-app.
androidInstalled: Kufakiwe. Vulani isibane kanye lamanye ama-app enu.
androidSteps:
• Vulani iBhayibhili ku-Chrome, kumbe esipheqululini elisisebenzisayo.
  • Vulani imenyu yesiphequluli, kanengi amachaphaza amathathu {svg} phezulu kwesokudla.
  • Thintani Install and create shortcut (ezinye iziphequluli zithi Add to Home screen).
  • Khethani Install, hatshi Create shortcut. Lapho-ke lithinte Install futhi.
  • Isibane sizavela lamanye ama-app enu.
computerNote: Ivuleka ewindini layo, njengayo yonke enye i-app.
computerInstalled: Kufakiwe. Vulani i-My Quiet Bible kanye lamanye ama-app enu.
computerSteps:
• Vulani iBhayibhili ku-Chrome kumbe ku-Edge.
  • Chofozani isithombe sokufaka ekupheleni kwesokudla somgqa wekheli, isikrini esilomtshoko {svg}, lapho-ke Install.
  • Kumbe vele ligcine ithebhu. Isebenza ngendlela efanayo, njalo ikhumbula indawo yenu.
footNote: Yonke imibhalo ingeyomphakathi kumbe ilelayisensi evulekileyo. Ilayisensi yenguqulo ngayinye ibhalwe ku-app.
prayP: ngelizwi, ngenkinobho eyodwa, ngalokho osanda kukubala.
shareP: ngemikhuleko yenu, nxa lifuna, labantu abalutshwana abaseduze lenu.
repeatP: kusasa. Igcina indawo yenu, lensuku zenu ezilandelanayo.
prayLong: Inkinobho ye-🙏 ihlala ikhona, eceleni komgqa wokudinga. Yithintani lisho umkhuleko wenu ngelizwi. Ugcinwa kanye lamavesi ebelibala, ngakho ngemva lingawuzwa futhi libone ukuthi belikhuleka ngani.
prayTicks:
• Akulalutho lokuthayipha njalo akulalutho lokulungisa.
  • Imikhuleko yenu ihlala efonini yenu, kumbe ivumelaniswe ikhiyiwe ngokhiye okulina kuphela.
circlesVerse: “Ngoba lapho ababili kumbe abathathu ababuthene khona ebizweni lami, ngikhona phakathi kwabo.”
circlesLong: Nxa lifuna, yenzani iqembu elincane lemuli yenu kumbe abangane abalutshwana. Yabelanani ngomkhuleko, ivesi kumbe inothi ngokuthinta kanye. Bayalalela, baphendule ngelizwi, kumbe baphendule nge-🙏, njalo ngulowo lalowo ubala ivesi eBhayibhilini lakhe.
circlesTicks:
• Akudingeki lanini. Akulalutho oluphuma efonini yenu ngaphandle kokuthi lithinte Yabelana.
  • Iqembu ngalinye lilokhiye walo. Ngamalunga alo kuphela angavula okukulo; lathi asikwenelisi.
  • Amaqembu adinga ukungena mahala, ngesikhiya sokungena kumbe ikhodi ethunyelwe nge-email.
listenP: Thinta ivesi, ubusuthinte Lalela. Kumbe uthinte Bala ulandela emgqeni wokudinga, njalo ilizwi ngalinye liyakhanya lisabalwa. Abafundi beqiniso babala iBSB, iKing James leLouis Segond. Okwemota, ekhitshini, kumbe amehlo adiniweyo.
